x-about: The kinds of resource the editor's guidance is measured for, and how to tell them. Read by scripts/guidance (to sample LC's records) and by the editor (to know what it's editing), so the two agree. The first rule that matches wins. A rule matches when the Work has one of its types, or the Instance one of its issuances; online rules also need the Instance's only carrier to be an online resource. Types, issuances and carriers are local names: Text, serl, cr. See docs/guidance.md.
